name: Almas
sum: Troodontid from the late Campanian Djadochta Formation of Mongolia known from a partial articulated skeleton.
holotype: A partial articulated skeleton, Djadochta Formation, Mongolia (Pei et al. 2017).
biology: Its slender hind limbs indicate rapid locomotion; its teeth and skull suggest an opportunistic diet.
author: Pei et al. 2017

sources.text: R. Pei, M. A. Norell, and D. E. Barta, G. S. Bever, M. Pittman, X. Xu. 2017. Osteology of a new Late Cretaceous troodontid specimen from Ukhaa Tolgod, Ömnögovi Aimag, Mongolia. American Museum Novitates 3889:1-47
